typeName.description: Name of the target C3 type

actionName.description: Name of the target C3 action

args.description: The pre-specified parameters of the action, keyed by parameter name.

dataTransforms.description:
List of data transform types, which will be applied after the data is
received but before saving it in the state.

Constraint: These types must extend {@link UiSdlDataTransform}.

allowMultipleInProgressRequests.description:
Whether to allow multiple in-progress requests for the same data ID.
Should be used in cases where data should be written multiple times concurrently,
just with different arguments.

allowDuplicateRequests.description:
Whether to allow duplicate sequential requests with the same arguments. If this is false,
if a data request A was just made with certain arguments, and data request B
is made again with the same arguments, the request B will be ignored. If a
request is made with different arguments between those two requests, the
request B will be allowed.

Use this in cases where the underlying data can change, and can be updated in the UI
using the same arguments. If this is not enabled for these cases, the user will have to
refresh the page to get the latest data.

doNotAutoRequest.description:
Whether to automatically request data when the action is updated due to context vars or state changing.
If this is false, the data will not be requested automatically when the action is set.
The user will have to manually request the data.

title: An action that can be used to request data with a {@link UiApDataStore}.
name: UiApDataStoreAction
